title: Honey-Glazed British Daikon Eton-Mess
description: A refreshing, energizing side dish made with daikon, honey, and lemon, perfect for a British-inspired meal.
instructions: Make pastry dough by combining flour, eggs, and water in a bowl, mixing until a cohesive mass forms.
Wrap daikon in the pastry dough, leaving a small opening at the top.
In a separate bowl, mix honey, lemon juice, thyme, salt, and pepper to create the glaze.
Place the daikon in a baking dish and brush the honey glaze on top.
Bake for 25 minutes, then remove the daikon from the oven and brush with additional glaze.
Return the daikon to the oven and bake for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
Let the daikon cool for a few minutes before serving.
Remove the pastry from the daikon and discard the pastry.
Serve the warm daikon with the remaining honey glaze spooned over the top.
Garnish with fresh thyme if desired.
Slice the daikon into wedges and serve immediately.
Serve as a side dish or add to salads for a bit of crunch and flavor.
